_source: Placement library (3/N). Ascendant (lagna) personality, keyed by rising sign. Used by InterpretationService for the kundli summary/guidance. Payload { summary, guidance }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=sign-traits` to fill the other 11 locales (until then non-English kundli requests use the localized LLM path via renderStatus().matched).

en.summary: With Aries rising, you meet life head-on — bold, energetic, and pioneering, happiest when you're starting something and leading the way.
en.guidance: Lean into your initiative and courage, but build patience and follow-through so your fast starts become lasting wins.

en.summary: With Taurus rising, you're steady, grounded, and patient, with a love of comfort, beauty, and security built to last.
en.guidance: Trust your persistence and calm, while staying open to change so your love of stability never hardens into resistance.

en.summary: With Gemini rising, you're curious, quick, and communicative — a versatile mind that thrives on learning, variety, and connection.
en.guidance: Channel your many interests by finishing what you start; depth will make your natural cleverness truly powerful.

en.summary: With Cancer rising, you're sensitive, caring, and intuitive, deeply tied to home, family, and emotional security.
en.guidance: Honor your nurturing nature, and protect your energy with healthy boundaries so caring for others never drains you.

en.summary: With Leo rising, you're warm, confident, and naturally expressive — a born leader who shines when appreciated and creative.
en.guidance: Lead with generosity and heart, and let humility temper pride so your light draws people in rather than overshadowing them.

en.summary: With Virgo rising, you're practical, analytical, and helpful, with a sharp eye for detail and a drive to improve things.
en.guidance: Use your precision to serve and refine, but ease the self-criticism — progress matters more than perfection.

en.summary: With Libra rising, you're gracious, fair-minded, and relationship-oriented, with a natural gift for harmony and diplomacy.
en.guidance: Cultivate balance in your bonds, and practice deciding for yourself so harmony never comes at the cost of your own needs.

en.summary: With Scorpio rising, you're intense, perceptive, and resilient, drawn to depth, truth, and transformation.
en.guidance: Trust your powerful intuition and focus, and release control where you can — vulnerability deepens your strength.

en.summary: With Sagittarius rising, you're optimistic, adventurous, and truth-seeking, energized by freedom, learning, and big horizons.
en.guidance: Follow your love of growth and exploration, while grounding your vision in commitment so your goals become real.

en.summary: With Capricorn rising, you're disciplined, ambitious, and responsible — a patient builder who earns lasting success.
en.guidance: Keep climbing with your characteristic steadiness, and make room for rest and warmth so achievement doesn't crowd out joy.

en.summary: With Aquarius rising, you're original, independent, and forward-thinking, with a humanitarian heart and your own way of seeing.
en.guidance: Honor your individuality and ideals, and stay emotionally connected so your big-picture vision includes the people close to you.

en.summary: With Pisces rising, you're compassionate, imaginative, and intuitive, attuned to feelings and the unseen currents of life.
en.guidance: Trust your empathy and creativity, and keep gentle boundaries so your sensitivity becomes a gift rather than a burden.
